SELECT b.name AS branchName, m.material_name AS materialName, DATE_FORMAT(bs.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS receivedDate, DATE_FORMAT(bs.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireDate, DATEDIFF(bs.expire_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(bs.expire_date, CURDATE()) <= 1 THEN 'urgent' WHEN DATEDIFF(bs.expire_date, CURDATE()) <= 3 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'normal' END AS riskType, bs.current_qty AS qty, m.unit AS unit
FROM branch_stock bs
JOIN branch b ON bs.branch_code = b.branch_code
JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code
WHERE bs.current_qty > 0 AND bs.expire_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(bs.expire_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 7
AND bs.branch_code = #{branchCode}
AND bs.expire_date <= DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY b.name ASC, bs.expire_date ASC, m.material_name ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(bsch.changed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS disposalDate, b.name AS branchName, m.material_name AS materialName, ABS(bsch.change_amount) AS qty, m.unit AS unit, ABS(bsch.change_amount) * IFNULL(m.material_price, 0) AS lossAmount, d.reason_detail AS reason
FROM branch_stock_disposal_history d
JOIN branch_stock_change_history bsch ON d.change_id = bsch.change_id
JOIN branch_stock bs ON bsch.branch_stock_code = bs.branch_stock_code
JOIN branch b ON bs.branch_code = b.branch_code
JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code
WHERE bsch.change_type = 'DISPOSAL'
AND bs.branch_code = #{branchCode}
AND DATE(bsch.changed_at) >= #{startDate}
AND DATE(bsch.changed_at) <= #{endDate}
ORDER BY bsch.changed_at DESC
